conclusion.reasoning: Both signed lineage artifacts for R-C04's target claim -- the FFW physical-baseline receipt (input_csv_sha256) and the parent ML B4 HistGBM model receipt (dataset_local_csv_sha256) -- were fit against a CSV whose sha256 is byte-identical to the raw_sha256 recorded in this module's own quarantine acquisition-receipt.json and normalized-dataset manifest.json for the Polyverse melt-viscosity dataset (quarantined=true, rights_class=CONTEXT_ONLY). The rights decision's own basis text explicitly extends the quarantine to 'all derivatives', not just the raw file. Producing the per-row prediction arrays R-C04's pre-registered protocol needs (test_row_polymer_id, test_row_y_true, test_row_y_pred_B3, test_row_y_pred_B4) requires re-running the identical fitting step against this identical quarantined-raw-hash CSV and persisting a NEW derivative artifact -- exactly what 'physically quarantine all derivatives' covers. Fire 1's checkpoint receipt asserted the opposite ('no rights review is needed... not the quarantined row-level CSV') without checking the hash; that assertion is refuted by this comparison. The correct remediation path is therefore blocked on the same pending counsel review already flagged by R-A03/mission.md, not on an unblocked engineering re-run.
